fields.description: The Wilds brings Cassia Villas and Ravenna Residences into a landscape of gardens, trails and outdoor gathering spaces. The reviewed villa collections offer three to five bedrooms, with different footprints for family routines. The Wilds Residences apartments have their own separate page.

research.community: The Wilds · Cassia Villas and Ravenna Residences
overview: The community is arranged around greenery and outdoor activities, with The Nest as a shared social destination. Its planting and wildlife features form part of the wider setting rather than a promise of a particular view from every home. Compare the selected plot with the approved community plan.
research.locationNote: Property Finder places The Wilds in Dubailand, Dubai. Confirm the approach road and villa cluster before comparing daily travel routes.
research.priceNote: Property Finder gives AED 5.1m as the launch reference and marks developer stock sold out. This does not establish a currently available home or resale asking price. Obtain a dated quotation and purchase-cost breakdown.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder reports 10% at booking, 55% during construction and 35% on handover. Remaining balances and dates depend on the selected contract and payments already made.
research.handoverNote: Aldar’s FY2025 pipeline lists completion in 2029. Property Finder lists January 2029 in its key facts but April 2029 in its description and FAQ. The reviewed Aldar pages do not resolve the discrepancy; obtain the selected phase’s current contractual schedule.

facts.label: Comparing layouts
facts.value: The drawings distinguish gross saleable area from plot size. Cassia and Ravenna show ground and first floors; Ravenna’s larger footprint is a separate villa collection, not an apartment category.

facts.label: Optional services
facts.value: Aldar Plus lists housekeeping, gardening, pet care and other assistance on request for an additional fee. These services are not represented as included in the purchase price.

unresolved: Completion dates conflict within the portal source and require developer confirmation.
Current stock, price, plot area, service charges and the payment contract remain unit-specific.
Private pools shown in drawings or renders are not confirmed as a standard inclusion.
Separate apartment and mansion releases must not inherit these villa sizes or payment terms. Images remain illustrative.
